title: Automatic same-project root access to original structured review results
outcome: An eligible native root of the original review project can read the exact original structured review result as itself through a pure, nonexclusive, bounded archive read, preserving explicit unavailable states and every execution and landing authority boundary.
acceptance:
The root already responsible for continuing the work calls the supported exact review-result read AS ITSELF.
   - The host automatically authorizes the original project's actual native root (host-recorded projectId; not a child, hidden, removed or proxy session), scoped to the requested original delegation, attempt and result identity.
   - No manual grant, parent consent, live claim, special coordinator role or Greg intervention.
   - Project association is immutable in new commissioning and archive records. Legacy association is recovered only from consistent native stored facts, never by guessing from the brief or cwd; otherwise the read returns project_basis_missing.
   - Foreign-project roots gain no ambient access.

The read returns the same original, complete, validated structured packet and provenance, through the existing archive with bounded paging. No prose reconstruction, export, hash or signature ceremony.
   - Pending/unpromoted, failed, held, missing, quarantined, conflicting and superseded states remain explicit.
   - Only the appropriate original final attempt counts, under the unchanged review, input and clean-carry rules.

The pure read never calls the mutating parent GET or recovery, never changes lifecycle, claims or waits, never ACKs mail and never starts commands.
   - Any explicit audit recording is separate from parent mutation.
   - Repeated and concurrent reads return the same original result.
   - Reuse the ea2e archive work, without claiming it has shipped or that its current read is pure. No duplicate archive.

Reads are non-exclusive: no exclusive takeover and no reader owner. If the first reader fails, another eligible root issues the same supported read, and a returning original parent can read too.
   - No new scheduler, handoff registration, lease, acceptance fence or backend election.
   - Outage detection does NOT gate the read.
   - Explicit Stop/pause and every execution and landing authority boundary remain. A read grants no parent identity, child control, review submission or commit power.
